# google_discovery_engine_user_license

Represents a user license assignment record in a Discovery Engine UserStore.
User licenses are created, updated, and unassigned through the parent
UserStore's batchUpdateUserLicenses endpoint.


To get more information about UserLicense, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.userStores.userLicenses)
* How-to Guides
    * [Manage user licenses](https://cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-license-users)

## Example Usage - Discoveryengine User License Basic


```hcl
resource "google_discovery_engine_license_config" "basic" {
  location          = "global"
  license_config_id = "lc-id"
  license_count     = 50
  subscription_tier = "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_NOTEBOOK_LM"
  start_date {
    year  = 2099
    month = 1
    day   = 1
  }
  end_date {
    year  = 2100
    month = 1
    day   = 1
  }
  subscription_term = "SUBSCRIPTION_TERM_ONE_YEAR"
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_user_license" "primary" {
  location       = google_discovery_engine_license_config.basic.location
  user_principal = "user@example.com"
  license_config = google_discovery_engine_license_config.basic.name
  user_profile   = "Example User"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `user_principal` -
  (Required)
  The user principal of the User, which may be an email address or a
  Workforce Identity principal identifier.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The geographic location where the user store resides. The value can only
  be one of "global", "us" and "eu".


* `license_config` -
  (Optional)
  The full resource name of the LicenseConfig assigned to the user.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/licenseConfigs/{license_config}`.
  Omitting or clearing this field leaves the user record unassigned in the UserStore.

* `user_profile` -
  (Optional)
  The user profile display name (for example, full name).

* `user_store_id` -
  (Optional)
  The ID of the user store. Currently only accepts "default_user_store".

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
* `delete_unassigned_user_licenses` - (Optional) If true, destroying this resource unassigns the license and deletes the
unassigned user license record from the UserStore. If false, destroying
this resource unassigns the license while retaining the unassigned user
license record in `NO_LICENSE` state.



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/userStores/{{user_store_id}}/userLicenses/{{user_principal}}`

* `license_assignment_state` -
  License assignment state of the user. Possible values include
  `LICENSE_ASSIGNMENT_STATE_UNSPECIFIED`, `ASSIGNED`, `UNASSIGNED`,
  `NO_LICENSE`, `NO_LICENSE_ATTEMPTED_LOGIN`, and `BLOCKED`.

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when the user license was created.

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when the user license was last updated.

* `last_login_time` -
  Timestamp when the user last logged in. Empty if the user has never logged in.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 5 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 5 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 5 minutes.

## Import


UserLicense can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/userStores/{{user_store_id}}/userLicenses/{{user_principal}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{user_store_id}}/{{user_principal}}`
* `{{location}}/{{user_store_id}}/{{user_principal}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import UserLicense using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    userPrincipal = "<-required value->"
    location = "<-required value->"
    user_store_id = "<-optional value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_discovery_engine_user_license.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import UserLicense using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/userStores/{{user_store_id}}/userLicenses/{{user_principal}}"
  to = google_discovery_engine_user_license.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), UserLicense can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_discovery_engine_user_license.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/userStores/{{user_store_id}}/userLicenses/{{user_principal}}
$ terraform import google_discovery_engine_user_license.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{user_store_id}}/{{user_principal}}
$ terraform import google_discovery_engine_user_license.default {{location}}/{{user_store_id}}/{{user_principal}}
```
